_note: Copy to config.json. LOOPBACK ONLY (nginx terminates TLS in front — never bind 0.0.0.0). The UPSTREAM LLM KEY is read from the ENVIRONMENT ONLY (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY) — NEVER put it in this file; it is never returned in a response and never logged. The gateway holds NO wallet keys. Set AGENT_AUDIT_SALT in the environment so audit addrHash/sessionId are stable across restarts.
